title: USS Ranger Departs Bremerton
desc: Tugs tow the ex-USS Ranger (CV 61) through Port Orchard Bay, near Port Orchard, Wash. The ex-Ranger will be towed from the Navy’s inactive ships maintenance facility in Bremerton, Wash., to International Shipbreaking Ltd.’s ship dismantling facility in Brownsville, Texas, for complete dismantling and recycling. Ranger was decommissioned in 1993 following nearly 36 years of service. (U.S. Navy Video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Cory Asato/Released)

title: USS Ranger is towed away from Naval Base Kitsap-Bremerton
desc: 150305-N-IK337-082 BREMERTON, Wash. (March 5, 2015) - Decommissioned Forrestal-class aircraft carrier USS Ranger (CV 61) is towed away from Naval Base Kitsap-Bremerton. The Ranger is being towed to Brownsville, Texas, for dismantling. (U.S. Navy Photo by Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Christopher Frost / Released)
